paragraphs.source_en: News of Tsurumatsu’s illness spread through every street and alley. paragraphs.source_en: The great hall was piled high with gifts, but Tsurumatsu’s condition alternately improved and worsened. At times he sank into a stuporous sleep; at others he opened his eyes wide. When his spirits lifted, he would call out the dancers’ names or murmur the name of Ono no Otsū, only to fall asleep again soon afterward; no one knew whether he was awake or dreaming.
